subject: Post-demo recap: buying authorization, finance sponsor & marketplace interest
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avasolutions.com>, Leah Martinez <procurement@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap: buying authorization, finance sponsor & marketplace interest

Hi Jordan / Leah —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and a short list of open items so we can move toward a pilot purchase: 

Key takeaways from the call:
- Ava team prefers a centralized billing path for enterprise purchases (callout: potential PO route for platform purchases).
- Primary use case is content personalization and low-latency inference for user-facing features.
- No immediate need for an air-gapped on-prem install — hosted or Dedicated are options.

Open items / asks for procurement readiness:
1) Payment method preference: PO vs. card? If PO, do you need a vendor form and W-9 before issuing?
2) Marketplace interest: Are you evaluating AWS Marketplace (or other cloud marketplaces) or do you prefer a direct contract?
3) Budget & signatory mapping: Who is the budget owner and who will sign (name/email)? Any approvals beyond finance?
4) Timeline: expected date by which procurement will be ready to raise a PO (rough week/month is fine).

Attachments: I attached a one-page pricing extract and the standard SOW template for your planning (redwood-pricing-v3.csv, SOW-template.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan / Leah: confirm (1)-(3) above, and share any vendor forms you need completed.
- I’ll loop in our finance and legal (Marissa / Karthik) if you’d like us to start filling vendor paperwork or review terms.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up with procurement to walk through vendor steps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--
Note: attachments referenced: redwood-pricing-v3.csv, SOW-template.pdf

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avasolutions.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Martinez <procurement@avasolutions.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: buying authorization, finance sponsor & marketplace interest

Thanks Ben — great demo. Quick answers below and a couple of asks from procurement.

1) Payment method: For anything above ~$25k we prefer PO (purchase order) and invoice cadence. Low-dollar pilot buys sometimes go on card, but this will likely be PO.
2) Marketplace: we are evaluating AWS Marketplace for ease of procurement, but procurement typically prefers direct contracts for anything that requires specific SLAs or data handling clauses. So likely direct contract + PO.
3) Budget & signatory: Budget owner is Priya Sharma, VP of Data Products (priya.sharma@avasolutions.com). Final signatory for platform purchases is our Head of Finance (I will confirm name; Leah is copied here).
4) Timeline: aiming to issue a PO by end of month (target 2026-06-30) if vendor forms and basic T&Cs are OK.

Procurement asks:
- Please complete the attached vendor form if possible and return (I attached our vendor form to this reply).
- We will need a current W-9 and a contact at Redwood finance for onboarding.

I’ve attached our vendor form (Ava_Vendor_Form_Fillable.pdf). Leah — can you confirm the signatory once you have it?

Jordan
Director, Product
Ava Solutions

Thanks Jordan — that’s really helpful. Couple quick notes and a proposed plan so procurement has what it needs: 

What we can provide today:
- Completed vendor form (I’ve added this to the attachments list; see "Ava_Vendor_Form_Fillable.pdf" — we can return a filled copy once Leah confirms the specific fields).
- Current W-9 (I attached redwood-w9.pdf as part of the vendor packet).
- A short, redlined-friendly SOW template and the one-page pricing extract (attached).

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to return the completed vendor form + W-9 by 2026-06-10 EOD (I’ll have Marissa prepare the vendor packet).
2) Leah to confirm final signatory name / email so we can populate the SOW and PO recipient.
3) If procurement prefers direct contract (not marketplace), we can surface our standard data handling appendix and SOC2 evidence. Karthik — can you pull the SOC2 summary link and a one-pager on data controls?
4) Target: PO issued by 2026-06-30. If anything shifts earlier/later, we’ll adjust.

Attachment note: I uploaded the current pricing CSV as redwood-pricing-v3.csv; Marissa will attach the vendor packet (SOW-template.pdf, redwood-w9.pdf).

Would you like a short 15-min call with Leah and our finance/legal to walk the procurement steps? Happy to set that up this week.

Best,
Ben

- Please return a completed vendor form and current W-9. I attached our vendor form in Jordan's reply — we prefer PDF fillable.

I’ve attached the filled vendor checklist for internal review (Ava_Vendor_Form_Fillable.pdf). If you can return your completed copy and W-9 by COB 2026-06-10, procurement will begin onboarding and put the PO on the June queue.
